The '''Talhu Slotted Peaks''' were a natural formation located nearby the [[Shaelo Cliff]] on the planet [[Harix]]. The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] based a squad of [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighters]] behind the peaks.<ref name="Bring Me the Children" />
